## 2. Core Service Offerings

### A. Business Workflow Automation & Integrations
DotnLott designs and deploys secure, scalable workflow automations to eliminate manual operations and redundant data entry.
- **Key Integrations**: 
  - CRM platforms: Zoho CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot.
  - Communications: WhatsApp Business API, Slack, Telegram, Gmail/Outlook.
  - Productivity: Google Workspace (Sheets, Drive, Docs), Notion, Trello, Asana.
  - Payment Gateways: Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal.
- **Architectures**: Custom webhook endpoints, cron triggers, event-driven state synchronizers, self-healing retries.
- **Orchestration Tools**: n8n (Self-hosted or Cloud), Make.com, custom Node.js/Python server workers.

### B. Custom AI Agent & RAG Architectures
We develop context-aware AI systems that interface with your company's proprietary data under strict privacy rules.
- **AI Agents**: Lead generation agents, automated customer support handlers, and sales pipeline assistants.
- **RAG Systems**: Retrieval-Augmented Generation using high-speed vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector) to query private business databases and documentation securely.
- **LLM Integrations**: OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5, Google Gemini, and open-source models (Llama 3) running on private cloud GPU servers.
- **Security**: Endpoint encryption, API key vaulting, prompt guardrails, and role-based data access.

### C. Full-Stack Web Development & Engineering
We build bespoke web applications and high-conversion marketing portals optimized for speed, scalability, and UX.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js (React 19), Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM.
- **Headless Commerce**: Custom fast checkout interfaces decoupled from Shopify, WooCommerce, or custom databases to achieve sub-second load times.
- **Performance Optimization**: Sub-second TTFB, 100/100 Lighthouse performance scores, static page generation (SSG) with ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration).
- **Hosting & Infrastructure**: Managed cloud (Vercel, AWS) or custom clusters on Hetzner Cloud and DigitalOcean VPS arrays.

---

## 3. Our 4-Step Delivery Process

1. **Discover (Scoping & Analysis)**: We map your team's manual steps, identify repetitive data entry patterns, gather API credentials, and write exact system requirements.
2. **Design (Architecture & Flowcharts)**: We model data structures, draft API mapping schemas, design wireframes, and outline event-driven webhook flows.
3. **Deploy (System Launch)**: We build components, run end-to-end tests, deploy code to Vercel/VPS clusters, and establish automatic error-monitoring webhooks.
4. **Support (Monitoring & Scaling)**: We review execution logs, keep API dependencies updated, adjust rate limits, and provide active maintenance options to ensure near-zero downtime.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### General & Automation FAQs
- **Q: How much does business workflow automation cost?**
  - **A**: Standardized automation setups at DotnLott start at ₹499 ($6) on our Managed Cloud model. Custom enterprise integrations are scoped and quoted after a consultation call.
- **Q: How long does it take to deploy an automation suite?**
  - **A**: Managed Cloud suites are configured, tested, and active in 3 to 7 business days. Complex enterprise multi-app web hooks take 2 to 4 weeks.
- **Q: Can you integrate legacy CRM databases?**
  - **A**: Yes. We design custom Node.js connectors to sync legacy systems (SQL Server, private REST APIs) with modern CRM and messaging platforms.
- **Q: Is our corporate data secure in custom automations?**
  - **A**: Yes. We do not store your data on intermediate servers unless required. API connections are end-to-end encrypted, credentials are vault-stored, and we support self-hosting options where you maintain 100% control of the host environment.

### Web Development FAQs
- **Q: How long does website development take?**
  - **A**: Standard marketing websites take 2 to 4 weeks. Full-stack custom web applications with portals and database states take 4 to 8 weeks.
- **Q: Do you build custom e-commerce systems?**
  - **A**: Yes. We build high-performance e-commerce storefronts using headless architectures connected to secure checkout gateways (Razorpay, Stripe) and inventory APIs.
- **Q: Why use custom Next.js code instead of WordPress or Shopify?**
  - **A**: Next.js offers superior loading speeds (under 1 second), absolute design freedom, higher conversion rates, robust security, and seamless custom backend API integrations that WordPress cannot support cleanly.
